label: Tab
description: One panel of a tab group, with a short title and optional icon in the tab strip. A tab holds the same kinds of content as a column — cards, fields, display, collection, activity, and action elements — except another tab group.
usage: Title tabs with one or two words; the title is also the panel's accessible name.
Add an icon token only when every tab in the group has one.
Use a tab per kind of secondary content rather than mixing activity and related records in one panel.
constraints: title is required and at most 40 characters; icon must be an icon token (icon.<name>).
Children follow layout.column's allowed children, except layout.tab_group.
A tab whose children are all hidden for the viewer is removed from the tab strip.

binding.description: Structural only; children bind to the page's record.

accessibility.keyboard: Reached with Tab from the selected tab; content keys apply inside.
accessibility.notes: Labelled by its tab (aria-labelledby). Inactive panels are not rendered to assistive technology.

responsive: Panel fills the column width; content stacks like a column.

examples.description: Activity tab with the record feed
